freeForever: We think the tools you need to look after yourself should not be locked behind ads or a paywall. VitaLibre has no ads, no subscription, no account and no locked features. Everything it can do is available the moment you open it, and it will stay that way. The donations on the Donate screen are entirely optional and unlock nothing. They exist only if you want to help pay for the work, and we are grateful if you do.
nothingSent: VitaLibre does not transmit any information of any sort to the developer or to any third party: not your readings, not your identity, not your device details, not diagnostics. There is no analytics, no advertising, no tracking and no server. Every reading is stored only on this device. The only time anything leaves it is when you choose to send a reading to yourself with the Share button, which uses your own messaging or file app. The App Store processes donations as the payment provider and sees only what any app purchase discloses to it, which is nothing about your health.
disclaimer: Not a medical device, results provided are an estimate only.
regulatory: Not a medical device. Not FDA-cleared or CE-marked. Not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease or condition.
disclaimerBody: This app is for general wellness and information only. It does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any condition. Heart rate and blood pressure values are estimates, may be inaccurate, and have not been clinically validated. Do not use them to make medical decisions or to start, change or stop any treatment. Consult a qualified health professional for medical advice. If you think you may be having a medical emergency, contact your local emergency services.
calibrationHow:
Calibrate only when your blood pressure is typical for you: rested, calm and well. If it is not, wait. A calibration made when your pressure is unusual shifts every later reading until you reset it.

Choose one of two ways. Each has two steps, and both are done at rest.

A. With a fresh cuff reading
1. Rest for five minutes, then take a reading with a validated cuff.
2. Straight away, take a reading with the app, tap Calibrate and enter the cuff numbers.

B. With a known resting pressure
1. Under Calibration, enter your known resting pressure from an earlier cuff reading or a medical record, and tap Done.
2. While at rest, take a reading with the app straight away.

Reset in Calibration clears both.
